From the Bottom#000.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy [{~} Troll Hair]. Nakoba is at {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#001.src: Ah, hey there, human! I'm certain you've noticed the bazaar down here. It's a point of pride for the Dwarves- biggest marketplace of all the Dwarf cities!
From the Bottom#001.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#002.src: Specialty items you can't find anywhere else- All sorts of strange, wonderful, unique things. I've been looking for a few sundry items myself here.
From the Bottom#002.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#003.src: It's almost all barter, unlike the merchants above that deal in that shiny stuff. Which is...a little unfortunate for me, in a way.
From the Bottom#003.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#004.src: You see, I'm a historian by trade, but what I'm really after now is some Troll Hair. See, I really like the sme- er. It's good and sturdy for binding books- wait a second!
From the Bottom#004.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#005.src: YOU have some? Phenomenal! I can never get it myself- was never much of a fighter. Um, here! Let me trade you that, for...this!
From the Bottom#005.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#006.src: A Decorative Bottlecap Set! These were hard to come by, but I've got two sets of them anyways. Check them out! You'll learn a lot. Thank you very much, by the way!
From the Bottom#006.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#007.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy a [Decorative Bottlecap Collection]. Dobile is at {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#008.src: Minerals for sale! Minerals for sale! Come get your rare metals! We've got Kanderstone, Wynnic Copper, genuine {p} Sandstone, real Voidstone from the {p}!
From the Bottom#008.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#009.src: Human, you there! If you're interested in smithing, you've found the right place! ...so long as you like drinking Dwarven drinks. I'm looking for bottlecap sets in exchange for these.
From the Bottom#009.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#010.src: What's that look for? Are you new here or something? Never seen a bottlecap collector before? Or is that just your face?
From the Bottom#010.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#011.src: Wh- That! That's! I! How did you! It...It's in pristine condition! There's not a single cap missing! There's not even any dents from the bottle openers!!!
From the Bottom#011.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#012.src: There's no way you got those in person! You can't possibly understand the significance of what you're holding!! I! NEED! THEM!
From the Bottom#012.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#013.src: Here! My rarest metal! Take them! Take them and give me those bottlecaps! I've got to complete my collection!! Give it! Give it! Give it give it give it give it NOW!
From the Bottom#013.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#014.src: ...er. Ahem. I got carried away there. But...those bottlecaps are from the very first Dogun Festival. It wasn't even held in Courag at the time these were made!
From the Bottom#014.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#015.src: I'd love to talk about them more, but I can't spend too long on the sale, or other customers might go away. But you got a good deal with that Jasplite I gave you!
From the Bottom#015.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#016.src: Come to think of it, some guy wanted that stuff, but he didn't even have a plain ol' sodapop cap on him! I think he's right close by. Maybe you'd have some interest in what you're selling instead.
From the Bottom#016.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#017.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy some [Molten Jasplite Ingots]. Dorroc is at {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#018.src: Hm...a human trader? Well, I've heard of you, but I hope it isn't just the standard fare from you.
From the Bottom#018.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#019.src: Yes, I've seen quite a few of your type to this bazaar- Using the community forges and smithing tables in all. You seem to have metals in bulk...
From the Bottom#019.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#020.src: ...but probably ninety-eight out of a hundred of the metal ingots I've seen humans use have been trash quality! Worthless only for practice! I seek only the finest metals, you see.
From the Bottom#020.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#021.src: ...so, of course, you have to prove me wrong by having MOLTEN JASPLITE?! Oh, you must have gotten that from Dobile. Wouldn't have taken you as a bottlecap collector!
From the Bottom#021.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#022.src: I've been pestering him for a while about his stock. The metal of the Unseen Blade is very valuable, you see. It's fragile, yes...
From the Bottom#022.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#023.src: ...but to wield it is to channel the power of Ockar the Unseen Blade himself! The wartime taskmaster who cowed a hundred demons with a mere dagger!
From the Bottom#023.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#024.src: Sneaking behind the lines of the enemy, braving blistering heat! Remaining as a shadow, and cutting through sheer earth and magma without flinching!!
From the Bottom#024.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#025.src: ...erm, yes. Anyways! For that, I can give you nothing less than my rarest stock. A Golemlus Power Core. If Qira found out I had this, I'd be worse off than a dead man.
From the Bottom#025.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#026.src: She keeps the secrets of those creatures under lock and key- and it must be the ticket to unlocking that particular mystery. Treasure this, human! It is no mere Corkian battery.
From the Bottom#026.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#027.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy a [Golemlus Power Cell]. Lodog is at {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#028.src: Right chief, what can I do ya for? I got all kinds'a machines here. One of 'em's gotta catch your eye, y'hear?
From the Bottom#028.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#029.src: I jury-rigged this juicer! Put a lemon inside, give it some, heheh, juice, and you'll get yourself lemon juice in a jiff!
From the Bottom#029.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#030.src: Or how 'bout this coin-shooter? Turn the crank and this'll spit out any coin-sized object like nobody's business. Just, uh, don't aim it at any windows, unless you really hate that window.
From the Bottom#030.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#031.src: ...what? Oh, I see. You think you got somethin' that'll interest ME instead of the other way round. I gotcha. Well, lemme see it a sec.
From the Bottom#031.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#032.src: ...okay. I can't make heads or tails a' this thing. What'd you say it was again? Don't tell me this is some Corkus gadget from that not-so-{p}!
From the Bottom#032.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#033.src: ...a... A Golemlus Power Core...? This... hot DOG! Yahaaah, I'd heard about these wacko golem thingies ages ago, I always wanted to take 'em apart! Aw hell, but this is an opportunity!
From the Bottom#033.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#034.src: Gotta say, for something that came from that Hive it's a lot less purple and black and spidery-all-over than I expected. The complexity...this has gotta be the real deal, but...
From the Bottom#034.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#035.src: Feels like someone else made this. That Qira lady doesn't seem like the handsy type, and this is something like {~} mechanics, {~} magic. Just seems out of character.
From the Bottom#035.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#036.src: Ah, but I'm gettin' away from myself. Tell ya what- prob'ly went through a lotta trouble ta get this, and that means you got guts. You got bravery. You got STONES, human!
From the Bottom#036.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#037.src: So, how 'bout these Ice Drake Scales then? It fits a brave soul like you, it does! Take 'em with pride, there!
From the Bottom#037.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#038.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy the Ice Drake Scales. Mastro is at {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#039.src: Ardent Magma Crystals for sale! Pure, {~}! Accept no substitutes, unless you're paying in emeralds, in which case kindly substitute...a lot of them!!
From the Bottom#039.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#040.src: Human! You have a keen eye for prices and values! I can tell by that glint in your eye- a real MAN's spirit! Even if you aren't a man, your spirit shines all the same as a man...!
From the Bottom#040.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#041.src: A SALES MAN! YES! Macho and brave! Chiseled and strong! Strong enough to carry {~} Liquid Emeralds to trade for this brilliant Ardent Magma Crystal!
From the Bottom#041.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#042.src: ...but hold on a moment. Hold on just one moment. Do I detect...a vein of ICE in that manly aura? A chill, pushing against that spirit of market machismo?
From the Bottom#042.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#043.src: YES, I DO! Human, you have Ice Drake Scales! I needn't see them to be sure! I was right about you from the start- Such burning passion!!
From the Bottom#043.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#044.src: AND SUCH NAIVETE! Let me strengthen your MIND! Ice Drake Scales are indicative of a great challenge having been overcome! A truly macho trophy of accomplishment!
From the Bottom#044.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#045.src: To tame Ice Drakes required UNBREAKABLE will! To overcome the sheerest cold with MACHO HEAT! And to outshine demons of lava and flame with that same determination! Those scales represent such resilience!
From the Bottom#045.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#046.src: And yet...I must wonder. Such a fiery spirit you have- THOSE SCALES HOLD YOU BACK! Your spirit cannot be contained in such a manner!
From the Bottom#046.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#047.src: DISRESPECT YOURSELF NO LONGER! I DEMAND YOU HAND OVER THOSE SCALES! But you will not leave empty-handed, no no, friend!
From the Bottom#047.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#048.src: You have ignited my passion as a salesman, so I shall present you with one of my own greatest accomplishments! For a spirit so WHITE HOT, only an ARDENT MAGMA CRYSTAL is fitting!
From the Bottom#048.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#049.src: YES! Your soul shines brighter than the shimmer of EIGHT-HUNDRED-MILLION EMERALDS! Forever may your spirit BURN, human!
From the Bottom#049.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#050.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy an [Ardent Magma Crystal]. Dohstaj is at {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#053.src: ...he's married to his work. Would I were his.
From the Bottom#053.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#054.src: ...but business first. Wartime artifacts for sale.
From the Bottom#054.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#055.src: ...priciest thing is a Dogun Flameshooter. Practically invaluable. You want it?
From the Bottom#055.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#058.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy the [Dogun Flameshooter]. Syni is at {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#059.src: I can't stand this. I can't stand this! SHUT UP, MASTRO! NO ONE CARES ABOUT YOUR SWEATY SPIRIT OR WHATEVER!
From the Bottom#059.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#060.src: MY MACHISMO CANNOT BE CONTAINED! Your aversion only inspires my salesman's spirit! Ardent Magma Crystals! Pure, {~} gold! {~} Liquid Emeralds, {~} off! STRONG bargains!
From the Bottom#060.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#061.src: AAAGH! Stupid, stupid, stupid Dohstaj! I just need him to fork over that stupid Flameshooter and then I can get away from this tripe but he just! Won't! DO IT!
From the Bottom#061.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#062.src: No, look, human! Can't you see the kind of stress I'm under?! I don't care about your Flameshooter, I need to get my hands on Dohstaj's Flameshooter!
From the Bottom#062.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#064.src: ...wait. Wait wait wait that's Dohstaj's Flameshooter how in the world did you get it what what WHAT! How did you snap him out of his...emotions?!
From the Bottom#064.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#065.src: I've been trying to get a hold of that for a week straight! I already have the perfect trade lined up! Please, hear me out!
From the Bottom#065.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#066.src: I have here the Scepter of Draani Thunderwill I! Dohstaj only WISHES he could salvage something this juicy! The real, honest-to-goodness staff of the Wartime King!
From the Bottom#066.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#067.src: A war relic for a war relic. It's only a fair trade! Just be real careful- a theif's been skulking in the yellow stall by the bank trying to steal it from me.
From the Bottom#067.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#068.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy [Draani Thunderwill's Scepter]. Yobon is behind the stone walls at {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#069.src: ...so. I saw you talking with Syni.
From the Bottom#069.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#070.src: Pfft. Thief? I'm an honest man. Just following the old footsteps.
From the Bottom#070.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#071.src: I know you have the Scepter. I'd have thumped you and taken you if you were a Dwarf.
From the Bottom#071.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#072.src: But how 'bout we work out a deal, instead? Take this tablet.
From the Bottom#072.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#073.src: It'll explain everything. Dwarven History...if you can read it. I can. Won't let loose my secrets for free though.
From the Bottom#073.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#074.src: Hand over the Scepter, and I'll hand over the tablet.
From the Bottom#074.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#075.src: I won't translate it for you, but I'm sure there's some egghead who'll get back to you on what it means in...ten years or so.
From the Bottom#075.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#076.src: Good things come to those who wait for others to do the work for 'em, as they say.
From the Bottom#076.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#077.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy your [Eons-Lost Dwarven History Tablet]. Nakoba is at {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#078.src: Well, you've been busy, I see! You've been working this bazaar like a champion!
From the Bottom#078.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#079.src: I ought to tell my friends up at the topside shops- they really respect traders who know their way around a deal. You should be able to buy and use more items from the armories!
From the Bottom#079.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#080.src: I... haven't had such luck unfortunately. I think you might've picked the place clean, eheh. Don't suppose you've got one last deal up your sleeve, huh?
From the Bottom#080.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#081.src: Oh, really? Hah, I was just joking about that, but if you really do have an offer, go ahead and lay it on me!
From the Bottom#081.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#086.src: THAT'S ANCIENT HISTORY! FORMATIVE ANCIENT HISTORY!
From the Bottom#086.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#087.src: I recognize those runes, they're ancient Dwarven glyphs! This is slab number three! We already have the first, second, and fourth tablets, my team and I- this would finish the collection!
From the Bottom#087.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#088.src: I! I! I! Take! TAKE EVERYTHING I HAVE! TAKE IT ALL, I NEED THAT! I NEED TO DISCOVER THOSE ANCIENT SECRETS!
From the Bottom#088.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#089.src: AH! AHAHAHAHA! THE HISTORY! THE STORIES! THE EVERYTHING! IT'S BETTER THAN THE SMELL OF TROLL HAIR! AHAHAHAAAHAHHAHHAHAAAAAH!
From the Bottom#089.speaker: Nakoba
